name: JW Marriott Nashville
positioning: Luxury hotel in a 33-story oval glass skyscraper on the edge of downtown Nashville, right by the Music City Center, with a tropical rooftop pool deck and Bourbon Steak by Michael Mina on the top floor
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Nashville base near Music City Center, Nissan Stadium and the Schermerhorn Symphony Center
Guests who want skyline views from floor-to-ceiling windows and a rooftop pool deck with cabanas

facts.text: The hotel sits on the edge of downtown Nashville, right by the Music City Center.
Nissan Stadium, the Schermerhorn Symphony Center and Music City Center are among the nearby attractions.
The hotel is an oval glass skyscraper rising 33 stories.
Every guest room has floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
Rooms have marble bathrooms, rain showers and lush linens.
The rooms feature artwork that reflects the soul of Nashville.
The Presidential Suite has views of Nashville from the hotel's highest vantage point, including from its bedroom.
The rooftop pool deck has a freshwater swimming pool that is open year-round and heated in winter, plus private cabanas and daybeds.
Spa by JW is a full-service spa offering skin treatments and massages.
Spa by JW sits next to the 24-hour fitness center and neighbors the rooftop pool deck.
Bourbon Steak by Michael Mina is on the hotel's top floor, with skyline views.
Staff lead complimentary guided tours of the modern artwork shown throughout the hotel.

highlights.text: Bourbon Sky lounge has terrace seating that extends past the building's edge, with skyline views.
The hotel is an oval glass skyscraper rising 33 stories.
The hotel has a tropical rooftop pool deck.
Every guest room has floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
Staff lead complimentary guided tours of the modern artwork shown throughout the hotel.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
A daily destination fee applies; its inclusions include a food and beverage credit and daily admission for two to the Johnny Cash Museum.
Parking at the hotel is by valet.
